title: Prince Frederick of Orange to the Hereditary Prince, London, 7 May 1795 (KHA Koning Willem I XVIII-3; DECODE R2242)

steps.what: Fetched R2242 record and four images with the session cookie.
DECODE note points to R1892; same vertical digit pairs, so tried the R1892 key.
One ciphered word in the clear page 2: 24 43 25 55 15 15 65 = famille.
Two subagents transcribed p1 (4 lines), p3 (17 lines), p4 (8 lines + P.S.).
Page 1 clear Dutch under the cipher agrees with the R1892-key decrypt and fixes ~12 word signs.
p3-p4 decrypted with the R1892 key: alliance, scattered troops, Basel ratification, ambassadors to Paris, Robespierrism.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The 6x6 digit-square key the project had recovered ciphertext-only for R1892 (KHA Prins Willem V inv. 339) read this letter (KHA Koning Willem I XVIII-3) unchanged, as DECODE's own note on R2242 suggested; the clear Dutch written under page 1 confirmed it and fixed about a dozen word signs.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcription_p1/p3/p4.txt with the apply.py key (scratchpad measure_C_orange.py): 966 of 1,040 cipher tokens read; digit pairs in the square and the circle-dot DE sign read, other [sign:..] word signs and ?? pairs unread, except the 15 p1 signs whose values the clear text under the cipher gives. p1 111/111, p3 581/635, p4 274/294.
outcome.notes: All digit pairs map with the R1892 key; about twenty word signs on p3-p4 unread; several doubtful pairs in the LLM transcription.

gaps.item: about twenty word signs on p3-p4 (Λ, ∞, Δ, φ, script L, ⊥ ...)
gaps.detail: only the p1 signs are fixed by the clear text under it

gaps.item: p3 line 1 and p4 line 8, doubtful pairs across p3-p4
gaps.detail: LLM transcription only; a careful full-resolution second pass not done

prior.where: page 1 carries its own clear Dutch under the cipher; pages 3-4 not deciphered anywhere

human: Project-level: DECODE login cookie supplied, problem posed with /goal. No target-specific intervention.
